name: Wieshof
kurzbeschreibung: Jausenstation and guesthouse of the Wechselberger family in Hinterthiersee, a popular stop on the Tirolina ski slope in the Thiersee valley.
beschreibung: The Jausenstation Pension Wieshof of the Wechselberger family is located at around 1,000 metres above sea level in Hinterthiersee in the Thiersee valley, in the heart of the Kufsteinerland. The inn, kept in Tyrolean style with its cosy dining rooms and parlours, radiates a homely atmosphere. The small but fine menu offers dishes made with products mainly from the family's own farm or from the region, along with a glass of red wine or a freshly tapped beer. The Jausenstation stands halfway up the ski slope of the Tirolina ski area and is a popular stop for skiers; the illuminated toboggan run also begins right by the house. Those who wish to stay longer can spend the night in the cosy guest rooms. Families with children are especially welcome here. It is open from mid-March to mid-December, closed on Wednesdays.
